# CoreMedia

<!-- generated:header (isim/tools/coverage-summary.py; do not edit by hand) -->
**Symbols:** 14.3% of Apple's iOS API (343 of 2396, exact) · **Rows:** 83% (3: 2 ✅ 1 🟡) · **iOS:** 4.0+
<!-- /generated:header -->

**Area:** [Media](../COVERAGE.md#media) · **Apple:** [CoreMedia](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/coremedia) · **Issues:** [`area:media`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Amedia)

## How isim implements it

- **Adapted:** a Swift overlay plus a `CMTime` C API (`isim/frameworks/CoreMedia/CMTime.c`). Clocks are the host's monotonic clock.

## API

| API / feature | Status | iOS | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CMTime`, `CMTimeRange` (CoreMedia) | ✅ | ≤17 | arithmetic, comparison, conversion, `NSValue(time:)` |
| `CMClock`, `CMTimebase`, `CMSync…` (CoreMedia) | ✅ | ≤17 | the host time clock (monotonic, shared with capture timestamps and `CACurrentMediaTime`); timebases on clocks or timebases with rates, anchors, timers and notifications; audio clocks follow the host clock (adapted: no drifting hardware clock); `AVCaptureSession.synchronizationClock`, `AVPlayerItem.timebase`; tested (HelloAssets: a timer at timebase time 0.6 fires after 0.3 s at rate 2) |
| `CMSampleBuffer`, `CMFormatDescription`, `CMBlockBuffer`, CoreVideo `CVPixelBuffer` (+ pools) | 🟡 | ≤17 | a sample buffer holds a decoded frame (CVPixelBuffer in main memory: BGRA/ARGB/RGBA/24RGB, one-component 8/16/half/float, depth and disparity, 14-bit Bayer, 420v/420f), interleaved PCM, or compressed samples (sizes, timing, sample attachments; format descriptions with codec configuration atoms, H.264 / HEVC parameter sets, magic cookies); block buffers own copies of the memory they are given (adapted); attachments; tested through capture, reader and writer (HelloCapture, HelloAssets). No IOSurface; Metal texture caches belong to Metal (not in isim). Missing: `CVBuffer` attachments, `CVPixelBufferCreateWithPlanarBytes`, texture caches, IOSurface; no C interface for CoreVideo |
